---
title: "aws_quick_sight_dashboard"
description: "`aws_quick_sight_dashboard` publishes a real, read-only, shareable view of an `aws_quick_sight_analysis`..."
---

`aws_quick_sight_dashboard` publishes a real, read-only, shareable view of an `aws_quick_sight_analysis`, the resource end users actually open to view visuals rather than edit them. Like Analysis and Template, its own visualization-definition schema is real but too deeply nested for individual field-level AI description, a documented exclusion in this corpus.

## Example

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
    	quick "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-aws/sdk/go/aws/quick"
    	ubx "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-go/runtime"
    )

    func main() {
    	ubx.Main(ubx.Stack("example", func() {
    		ubx.Intent(ubx.IntentInfo{Summary: "example own sight dashboard"})

    		ubx.Resource(quick.SightDashboard, "example", quick.SightDashboardConfig{
    			AwsAccountId:             "example",
    			DashboardId:              "example",
    			Name:                     "example",
    			DashboardPublishOptions:  map[string]any{"ad_hoc_filtering_option": map[string]any{"availability_status": "example"}},
    			Definition:               map[string]any{"data_set_identifier_declarations": []map[string]any{{"data_set_arn": "example"}}},
    			FolderArns:               []string{"example"},
    			LinkEntities:             []string{"example"},
    			LinkSharingConfiguration: map[string]any{"permissions": []map[string]any{{"actions": []string{"example"}}}},
    		})
    	}))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="TypeScript">
    ```typescript
    import { intent, resource, stack } from "@ubx/sdk";
    import { SightDashboard } from "@ubx/sdk-aws/aws/quick/sight_dashboard";

    export default stack("example", () => {
      intent({ summary: "example own sight dashboard" });

      resource(SightDashboard, "example", {
        awsAccountId: "example",
        dashboardId: "example",
        name: "example",
        dashboardPublishOptions: {
          adHocFilteringOption: { availabilityStatus: "example" },
        },
        definition: { dataSetIdentifierDeclarations: [{ dataSetArn: "example" }] },
        folderArns: ["example"],
        linkEntities: ["example"],
        linkSharingConfiguration: { permissions: [{ actions: ["example"] }] },
      });
    });
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Python">
    ```python
    import ubx_sdk as ubx
    from ubx.aws.quick import SightDashboard, SightDashboardConfig

    def describe():
        ubx.intent("example own sight dashboard")

        ubx.resource(SightDashboard, "example", SightDashboardConfig(
            aws_account_id="example",
            dashboard_id="example",
            name="example",
            dashboard_publish_options={"ad_hoc_filtering_option": {"availability_status": "example"}},
            definition={"data_set_identifier_declarations": [{"data_set_arn": "example"}]},
            folder_arns=["example"],
            link_entities=["example"],
            link_sharing_configuration={"permissions": [{"actions": ["example"]}]},
        ))

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        ubx.run("example", describe)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Markdown">
    ```
    Create aws_quick_sight_dashboard called "example", with aws
    account id example, dashboard id example, dashboard publish
    options a set value, definition a set value, folder arns a set
    value, link entities a set value, link sharing configuration a
    set value.
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
